# Verified sources for the benchmark concepts

Checked 2026-10-02. Percentages are task success unless another metric is named. pp means percentage points. Studies use different tasks and cannot support a combined model ranking. Cite factual values and link to each publisher; do not reproduce their charts, images or prose. No blanket content-reuse permission is assumed.

| Who and date | Setup | Without / with / effect | Primary source | Permission note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Edge, published October 2, 2026 | Sonnet 5.5; frozen domain-balanced SkillsBench sample; 32 tasks, 95 baseline and 94 curated-skill scored runs; skills explicitly requested in treatment | 30.5% / 54.3%; task-paired mean +24.0 pp, task-bootstrap 95% CI +10.9 to +38.0 | [Study](https://getedge.cc/benchmarks/skillsbench-sonnet-5-5/), [summary](https://getedge.cc/benchmarks/skillsbench-sonnet-5-5/summary.json) | Edge-owned result and newly drawn chart. |
| Edge, run October 1, published October 2, 2026 | Sonnet 5.5; 12 study-written personal workflow tasks; 2 trials per arm; 48 total runs; skill mounted with the same task prompt and no nudge, all 24 skill-arm trials loaded it | 4/24 = 16.7% / 14/24 = 58.3%; published rounded paired lift +42 pp; CI +8 to +71 | [Study](https://getedge.cc/benchmarks/own-workflow-skills/), [summary](https://getedge.cc/benchmarks/own-workflow-skills/summary.json) | Edge-owned; sensitive workflow evidence remains redacted. |

Cite numeric facts only; no chart/image reuse. Selected lift CIs are not transcribed, so mockups say CI not reported in the displayed source values. |

CI not reported in the selected values | [Paper and protocol](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.04323v1), [research code](https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/Skill-Usage) | Paper HTML identifies CC BY 4.0. Cite facts with author credit and link; no figures copied. Combined retrieval/refinement intervention, not isolated curated-skill supply. Listed as additional research rather than an interchangeable SkillsBench row. |

Additional searches covered Anthropic, OpenAI, SWE-bench variants and Terminal-Bench. [OpenAI's skill-eval guide](https://developers.openai.com/blog/eval-skills) gives a method, without a published numeric with/without effect; [Anthropic's SWE-bench agent article](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/swe-bench-sonnet) concerns broader agent design; [SWE-bench Verified](https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/) changes the evaluation set. These do not establish a matched skill-treatment result and are excluded from the numeric table. The targeted Terminal-Bench search verified the retrieval/refinement result recorded above.

For the study chart, the live Edge summary supplies domain rate differences: Media +58.3, Finance +36.4, Industrial +33.3, Natural science +25.0, Cybersecurity +20.5, Software +16.7, Mathematics 0.0, Office 0.0 pp. Each domain has four sampled tasks. These are descriptive pooled differences, distinct from the overall task-paired lift.

Pending Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, 87-task roster and routing rows use the brief's Running presentation state. Unknown values remain Pending, never zero. The planned roster size is not a completed task count. Running means study work in progress, not a claim that model executions are currently active.


## Frozen UI inputs

`data/leaderboard-snapshot.json` contains 25 factual configuration rows captured from the [SkillsBench public leaderboard](https://www.skillsbench.ai/leaderboard) on October 2, 2026. The snapshot preserves the one-sided HY3 result with unknown baseline and lift. It is distinct from the 18-configuration paper aggregate. No charts or article bodies are copied. CI values were not transcribed and remain null.

Per-task public package identities are pinned in `data/skill-packages.json` at the repository root, reused from the UI input manifest. Links identify the SkillsBench task bundle; contributor attribution does not imply authorship by Edge. Page links are frozen snapshot mappings, with source/evidence fallbacks where no matching Edge page was known.
